title: The smallest congruent number curve of rank seven: a(7) = 797507543735 in OEIS A194687
description: We prove that a(7) = 797507543735 in OEIS A194687, i.e. for every positive integer k < 797507543735 the curve y^2 = x^3 - k^2 x has rank at most 6; previously only the upper bound (Rogers) was known. The proof is an exhaustive, unconditional computation (no GRH, BSD or parity conjecture): a Monsky 2-Selmer sieve over all squarefree k whose count 143452705272 is confirmed by an independent prime-counting method, PARI/GP ellrank upper bounds for all 9053344 candidates, isogeny-class refinement for the 163 residual cases, and an independent cross-check with Cremona's mwrank (866/866 and 1788/1788 agree). The record contains a 3-page note, all programs, the full certificate (candidate lists and per-k bounds) and a verifier that re-checks the certificate in about a minute. Generative AI (Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic) was used to write and run the programs and to help prepare the text, under the author's direction.
